name: Methane (CH4) Tetrahedral Molecule
semanticDescription: 3D ball-and-stick covalent molecular model of methane (CH4) exhibiting perfect tetrahedral geometry with four equivalent C-H single covalent bonds at 109.5 degree bond angles (CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Ch 4).
simplifications: Atoms represented by CPK color-coded spheres.
Covalent electron sharing represented by cylindrical chemical bond rods.
